subject.title: feat(runner): support OpenClaw plugins across the ClawHub profile

question: Should ClawScan adopt `plugin` as a public target/artifact kind and intentionally change existing plugin-directory dispatch and ambiguity behavior?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but repository history shows prior OpenClaw plugin work was intentionally moved off main, while this branch changes observable artifact values and existing scanner behavior; code review cannot safely infer that product reversal.

options.title: Approve the plugin contract
options.body: Merge the current design and treat explicit OpenClaw plugins as a supported first-class target with documented fail-closed ambiguity and scanner compatibility rules.

options.title: Preserve legacy directory behavior
options.body: Require plugin classification only when the manifest path or an explicit mode is supplied, avoiding behavior changes for existing directory targets.

options.title: Defer plugin support
options.body: Close or pause the PR until maintainers define a narrower plugin-scanning and artifact contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the plugin contract
recommendation.body: Merge the current design and treat explicit OpenClaw plugins as a supported first-class target with documented fail-closed ambiguity and scanner compatibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the relevant runner surface and authored the earlier commits that moved OpenClaw plugin work off main.
